change.description: Add a new method PlanWithFilter(ctx context.Context, metasByMinTime []*metadata.Meta, filter func(*metadata.Meta) bool) ([]*metadata.Meta, error) to the Planner interface. All concrete implementations of Planner must add this method to satisfy the interface. This affects both Thanos and Mimir, which have separate Planner interfaces with different signatures.

breaking_patterns.why_breaks: Concrete type that implements Planner interface does not have the new PlanWithFilter method, causing a compile error.
Test mocks and adapters that implement Planner interface must add the new method or tests will fail to compile.
